cells.message:
feat(api): add profile endpoint

Mobile client needs profile data without the full user
payload to reduce LTE bandwidth on cold-launch screens.

feat(api): add lightweight profile endpoint

The mobile client previously fetched the entire user payload
to render a profile screen. The new route serves only profile
fields, cutting bandwidth on LTE connections.

feat(api): add user profile route

Mobile client needs profile data without the full user
payload; the lighter response saves LTE bandwidth on cold
launch.

feat(api): add slim profile endpoint

Full user record is overkill for the profile screen; the
compact response reduces bandwidth for mobile clients.

api: add profile endpoint

The mobile client previously pulled the full user record to
render a profile screen. The new GET /users/{id}/profile
route returns a compact profile payload, so cold-launch
screens use less bandwidth on LTE.

api: add GET /users/{id}/profile

Before this change the profile screen loaded the complete
user object, which is heavier than what it displays. The
new route serves only the profile fields the screen needs,
cutting transferred bytes for mobile clients on slow
connections.

api: add lightweight profile endpoint

The profile screen renders a small subset of the user
record, yet the mobile client was fetching the entire
payload. This route returns just the profile data, which
trims bandwidth usage when the app cold-launches over LTE.

feat(api): add user profile endpoint

Adds GET /users/{id}/profile returning profile data only.
The mobile client needs this on cold launch; serving the
full user payload wastes LTE bandwidth.

feat(api): add profile endpoint for mobile clients

The mobile client fetches profile data without needing the
rest of the user record. This new route returns a compact
profile payload, reducing bandwidth usage on slow mobile
connections.

feat(api): add compact profile route

Previously the mobile app had to request the complete user
record to display a profile. The new GET /users/{id}/profile
endpoint returns only profile fields, lowering data
transferred during cold launch.
